description.value:
Your regalia grants you the true gravitas of rulership, tying together the hearts and minds of your allies and making it impossible for you to leave a bad impression. If you roll a critical failure on a check to @UUID[Compendium.avant.actionsavant.Item.Coerce], @UUID[Compendium.avant.actionsavant.Item.Make an Impression], or @UUID[Compendium.avant.actionsavant.Item.Request], you get a failure instead. When others use @UUID[Compendium.avant.actionsavant.Item.Follow the Expert] to follow you, you grant them a +3 circumstance bonus if you are trained or +4 if you are an expert or above.

Allies in your inspiring aura aren't @UUID[Compendium.avant.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] from being flanked unless you too are flanked. If one of your allies in the aura is @UUID[Compendium.avant.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy], @UUID[Compendium.avant.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled], @UUID[Compendium.avant.conditionitems.Item.Frightened], @UUID[Compendium.avant.conditionitems.Item.Sickened], or @UUID[Compendium.avant.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied], the status penalty your ally takes from the condition is 1 lower than the condition's value as long as the ally remains in the aura, unless you too are affected by the same condition.
